analysis.title: South Korea Technology: Nov. 2026 HBM tracker: upward revision in SK Hynix' HBM revenue/OP expectations
key_insights: New monthly HBM tracker covering four items: one-month change in consensus on Samsung Electronics (SEC) and SK Hynix HBM pricing and shipments (Oct 16 to Nov 15), HBM vs conventional DRAM vs DRAM spot pricing, GS 2026-2028 HBM ASP and bit shipment estimates vs consensus, and monthly Japanese HBM-material imports as a shipment proxy.

Over the past month, consensus for Hynix HBM ASP and shipments rose substantially. Hynix 2027 HBM revenue consensus was revised +25.3% and operating profit +29.7%. 2028 revenue was revised +15.1% and operating profit +12.0%. 2026 changed little (revenue +0.5%, operating profit -0.5%).
The Hynix 2027 revision is driven by pricing. Consensus 2027 HBM pricing growth rose 33.8 percentage points, while shipment growth rose 1.4 points.

SEC consensus moved the other way for 2026 and 2027. 2026 HBM revenue was revised -4.1% and operating profit -7.9%. 2027 revenue was revised -1.3% and operating profit -2.1%. 2028 revenue was revised +2.5% and operating profit -1.5%.

DDR5 spot prices remain well above GS ASP estimates. DDR5 spot is 110% above the 4Q26 HBM ASP estimate and 83% above the 4Q26 conventional DRAM ASP estimate (average of SEC and Hynix). GS says this premium leaves further upside to its near-term HBM and conventional DRAM ASP assumptions.

GS's 4Q26 conventional DRAM ASP estimate for the Korean suppliers is about 15% above its 4Q26 HBM ASP estimate. Exhibit 2 shows average HBM ASP of $1.8/Gb, conventional DRAM ASP of $2.1/Gb and DDR5 16Gb spot at $3.8/Gb.
DDR5 16Gb spot trades 21% above the latest contract price as of 11/16/2026.
GS HBM ASP estimates for SEC are above consensus from 2027. The 2027 estimate is 19% above and the 2028 estimate 7% above, based on continued HBM supply tightness and SEC's strong positioning.
For Hynix, 2028 consensus HBM ASP rose from $3.3/Gb to $3.8/Gb in a month. GS's own 2028 estimate is $3.0/Gb, so consensus is now well above GS.

Import proxies for HBM shipments: YTD October epoxide resin imports from Japan to Icheon/North Chungcheong (Hynix, MR-MUF material from Namics) rose 12% yoy. YTD October plastic film imports from Japan to Hwaseong/Pyeongtaek (SEC, TC-NCF material from Resonac) rose 51% yoy, which GS reads as potentially strong growth in SEC HBM shipments.
October single-month imports rose 51% yoy for Hynix epoxide resins and 34% yoy for SEC plastic film.

Valuation: GS target price for SEC common is W500,000 (EV/EBITDA-based SOTP) and for SEC preference W380,000 (24% pref-to-common discount), Buy on both. Hynix target price is W3,500,000 on a 9.0x target P/E using the 2026E/27E average.

Key risks named for SEC are a memory supply/demand deterioration, a sharp contraction in smartphone margins and mobile OLED share loss. Key risks for Hynix include a memory supply/demand deterioration, weaker device demand, Samsung's HBM progress and lower AI capex.

market_movers.rationale: Samsung Electronics common share, Buy rated on a 12-month EV/EBITDA-based SOTP target. GS HBM ASP estimates for 2027 and 2028 are 19% and 7% above consensus.
Samsung Electronics preference share, Buy rated, applying a 24% pref-to-common discount to the common target.

SK Hynix target price of W3,500,000 on a 9.0x P/E, set 31-May-26 and unchanged in this note. Consensus HBM revenue and operating profit expectations were revised sharply higher for 2027 and 2028 over the past month.

sector_views.rationale: GS sees continued HBM supply tightness. DDR5 spot trades far above its HBM and conventional DRAM ASP estimates, which it says leaves upside to those assumptions.

earnings_insights: Estimates only, no reported results. Hynix consensus HBM revenue (Visible Alpha, 11/15/2026 vs 10/15/2026) revised +0.5% for 2026, +25.3% for 2027 and +15.1% for 2028. Consensus HBM operating profit revised -0.5%, +29.7% and +12.0%.
SEC consensus HBM revenue (Visible Alpha, 11/15/2026 vs 10/15/2026) revised -4.1% for 2026, -1.3% for 2027 and +2.5% for 2028. Consensus HBM operating profit revised -7.9%, -2.1% and -1.5%.
SEC consensus HBM shipment growth for 2026 rose 7.9 percentage points while pricing growth fell 7.7 points. For 2027 shipment growth fell 5.5 points and pricing growth rose 12.3 points.
Hynix consensus 2027 HBM pricing growth rose 33.8 percentage points and 2028 shipment growth fell 5.2 points (consensus, not reported).

risk_factors: Major deterioration in memory supply/demand and delay in technology migration.
Weaker smartphone, PC and server demand, which would hit conventional memory demand.
Samsung's positive HBM business progress, which would reduce Hynix HBM revenue and profit.
Lower AI-related capex, which would reduce HBM demand.
For SEC: sharp contraction in smartphone margins and mobile OLED market share loss.
